title: A Strange Sound
shot: medium close-up, backlit by the entrance
camera: slow orbit from front to profile as he turns
action: KAIRO stands near the entrance. A mysterious sound drifts up from deep inside the cave. He turns sharply toward the dark passage.
lighting: warm daylight rim from behind him, black passage in front
audio: a low resonant tone with a faint pulse, like a struck stone; cave reverb
dialogue_fa: همون موقع یه صدا شنیدم... یه صدای عجیب. نه شبیه صدای حیوان بود، نه شبیه صدای آدم.
gloss_en: Right then I heard a sound... a strange sound. It was not like an animal, and not like a human voice.
continuity: passage opening is camera-right of the entrance wall, recreated in S17-S18
transition: his turn completes the move into the passage, motivating S17
image_prompt: Medium close-up of KAIRO the stickman standing at the cave entrance, backlit by warm daylight so his hide tunic and spear edge glow, face in soft shadow. Behind him the black passage opening. Small dust motes curl in the light. 2D cinematic animation, strong rim lighting, moody.
video_prompt: Slow orbit around KAIRO from the front to his profile. A resonant tone sounds; his head snaps toward the dark passage, eyebrows lifting, one hand tightening on the spear. The light behind him stays constant.
